summary: Iteration 3 testing (login brute-force lockout, new signature guitars galaxy-v/lightning-v, Guitar Stage home section, official store badges). Backend: 10/10 pytest passing (shop products, static assets, Stripe checkout, lockout flow 4x401→429 with Retry-After 900, admin login still works, wrong→correct clears counter). Frontend: home Guitar Stage renders both guitars at $249.00, add-to-cart opens drawer, shop signature filter + images (naturalWidth>0), store badges are with correct hrefs & target=_blank on both /apps and /apps/groovsesh (5 groups on /apps). Login page shows lockout message in auth-error after 5 wrong attempts. Stripe checkout button redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Admin regression login OK. No real console errors (only expected 401 from /auth/me pre-login and 429 from lockout test).
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout is IP+email keyed via x-forwarded-for; behind proxies this is correct but a shared corp NAT could lock out an unrelated user's email attempts — acceptable trade-off but worth noting.

login_attempts TTL index on updated_at with expireAfterSeconds=900 will remove lock records exactly at lockout window end (good), but also removes counters before max is reached if user idles ~15 min between attempts; acceptable.
Stripe images list uses raw product['image'] and prefixes only if it starts with '/'; external URLs (pexels/unsplash) pass through — fine.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create/cleanup login_attempts docs matching lock-*|cleartest-* prefixes and register throwaway users cleartest-<uuid>@test.com (not cleaned; not blocking).
